intro.text: Sottiaux 的重置进化为产品更新公告（**11970 赞**）——附带 GPT-5.6 Sol 用量限制更新。Levie 一条神秘重磅推文（**8594 赞**）+ 转发 Zuckerberg 的 AI 愿景文章（323 赞）。Sottiaux 还发布了开源安全 CLI 和 TypeScript SDK（5812 赞）+「reset button 的历史」（4056 赞）。Swyx 的就业市场观察引发共鸣（**721 赞**）：AI-native IC 和 player-coach 的牛市，「heads of X」管理者的熊市。Dan Shipper 早上在沙发上写了 Codex 的权威历史（178 赞）——基于与 Sottiaux、J Ambrosino、GDB 的深度访谈。Madhu Guru 的考古式观察（18 赞）：「今天看到一个 SWE 在工作。没有 Claude。没有 Wispr。没有 tab 键。就在那里。徒手写代码。」Garry Tan 论真诚（228 赞）。Peter Yang 用 Claude Design + Claude Code 建了 Tastemaker（48 赞）。Aditya Agarwal 回忆十年前的 Minus One 旅程（107 赞）。今天没有播客。

sections.title: Sottiaux's Reset Evolution & Open Source Security / Sottiaux 的重置进化与开源安全
sections.desc: Sottiaux 的重置+Sol 更新（**11970 赞**）+ 开源安全 CLI（**5812 赞**）+ reset button 历史（4056 赞）。

rewrite: Sottiaux's mega-reset tweet (11970 likes): 'Hello people of Sol! I've reset usage limits for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Together with that, a quick update on GPT-5.6 Sol usage limits. Over the past few weeks, many of you have told us that [limits were too tight].' The reset has become a product announcement vehicle.

His open source security release (5812 likes): 'More opensource goodness. We have just released a CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities in your code. Scan repositories, review changes, track findings.' — OpenAI commoditizing security tooling.
His philosophical reset retrospective (4056 likes): 'One day we created the reset button and the rest is history.'
original: Thibault Sottiaux: Hello people of Sol! I've reset usage limits for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users. A quick update on GPT-5.6 Sol usage limits.
Thibault Sottiaux: More opensource goodness. We have just released a CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities in your code.
Thibault Sottiaux: One day we created the reset button and the rest is history.

rewrite: Sottiaux 的超级重置推文（11970 赞）：「Sol 的人们好！我已经为所有 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户重置了用量限制。同时带来 GPT-5.6 Sol 用量限制的快速更新。过去几周，很多人告诉我们[限制太紧了]。」重置已经变成产品公告载体。
他的开源安全发布（5812 赞）：「更多开源好东西。我们刚发布了一个 CLI 和 TypeScript SDK，用于查找、验证和修复代码中的安全漏洞。扫描仓库、审查变更、跟踪发现。」——OpenAI 在将安全工具商品化。
他的哲学式重置回顾（4056 赞）：「有一天我们创造了重置按钮，剩下的就是历史了。」
original: Thibault Sottiaux：Sol 的人们好！已重置所有用量限制。附带 GPT-5.6 Sol 用量更新。
Thibault Sottiaux：刚发布了用于查找和修复安全漏洞的 CLI 和 TypeScript SDK。
Thibault Sottiaux：有一天我们创造了重置按钮，然后就是历史了。

sections.title: Bull Market for ICs, Bear Market for Managers / IC 牛市，管理者熊市
sections.desc: Swyx 的就业市场分化观察（**721 赞**）；Aditya Agarwal 的十年回顾（107 赞）；Dan Shipper 的 Codex 权威史（178 赞）；Madhu Guru 的考古发现（18 赞）。

cards.authorTag: swyx / Every CEO / AI 产品经理 / Credo AI

rewrite: Swyx's labor market analysis (721 likes): 'it's a huge bull market for AI-native IC's/player-coaches. It's a huge bear market for "heads of X" managers. Never seen such furious bifurcation. To oversimplify: 1 year experience [with AI tools] is worth more than 5 years [without].' The market is rewarding hands-on builders over middle management.

Dan Shipper's Codex history (178 likes): 'i spent the morning writing the definitive history of codex on my couch. it comes from hours of in-depth interviews with the team including @thsottiaux, @ajambrosino, and @gdb. my hands didn't touch [a keyboard without AI].' — meta-narrative about using AI to write about AI.

Madhu Guru's archeological find (18 likes): 'I saw a SWE at work today. No Claude. No wispr. No tab key. Just writing code. With his bare hands.' Aditya Agarwal's decade reflection (107 likes): 'A decade ago as I was going through my own Minus One journey, I got 2 pieces of deep personal insight: 1/ I want to build new things. 2/ I want to w[ork with great people].'

rewrite: Swyx 的劳动市场分析（721 赞）：「现在对 AI-native IC 和 player-coach 是巨大的牛市。对「heads of X」管理者是巨大的熊市。从没见过如此剧烈的分化。简单说：1 年[AI 工具]经验比 5 年[没有]更值钱。」市场在奖励动手的 builder 而非中层管理。
Dan Shipper 的 Codex 历史（178 赞）：「早上在沙发上写了 Codex 的权威历史。来自与团队数小时深度访谈，包括 @thsottiaux、@ajambrosino 和 @gdb。我的手没有[在不用 AI 的情况下]碰过键盘。」——用 AI 写关于 AI 的元叙事。
Madhu Guru 的考古发现（18 赞）：「今天看到一个 SWE 在工作。没有 Claude。没有 Wispr。没有 tab 键。就在那里。徒手写代码。」Aditya Agarwal 的十年回顾（107 赞）：「十年前我经历自己的 Minus One 旅程时，得到了两条深刻的个人洞察：1/ 我想创造新东西。2/ 我想和[优秀的人一起]工作。」

rewrite: Peter Yang built Tastemaker (48 likes): 'I got tired of using IMDb to rate movies and Letterboxd doesn't support video games. So I built Tastemaker to let anyone curate their favorite movies, TV shows, and games.' Made with Claude Design + Claude Code, with a full process video. He also questioned Codex model tiers (34 likes): 'I had no idea that Sol Pro even existed — is this better than Sol High?'

Garry Tan on earnestness (228 likes): 'It's OK to joke, but when it comes to your life, your intention, and your weltanschauung, be earnest as fuck.' Plus his SF sanctuary policy posts (93 likes, 25 likes).

Amjad Masad's three tweets: rare books concern (122 likes) — 'Who's writing an open letter against destroying rare books?' SETI@Home for math (40 likes): 'Imagine SETI@Home but instead you donate compute to search math proofs.' Chess engine update (63 likes): '1300 Elo!' — climbing toward his 2000+ goal with one small finetuned LLM.
